# AR VoiceQR Project Instructions

This is an AR VoiceQR web application that displays zodiac AR holograms based on URL parameters.

## Project Overview
- Web-based AR application for zodiac signs
- Integrates with Google Apps Script for data retrieval
- Displays video holograms, stone images, and messages
- Uses URL parameters to determine zodiac sign

## Technology Stack
- HTML5
- CSS3
- Vanilla JavaScript
- Google Apps Script integration

## Development Guidelines
- Focus on web technologies and AR visualization
- Maintain responsive design principles
- Ensure cross-browser compatibility
- Keep code modular and well-commented
